ideas.idea: Add a short descriptive text on the home page about what the shop sells and where it ships
ideas.why: The home page has only an h1, so added descriptive text gives readers and machines real context.

ideas.idea: Give each product category/item its own page so Product data describes a real item
ideas.why: /shop is a single page with a bare Product entry and no per-item pages, so separate pages would give crawlers distinct things to index.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag in src/app.html
ideas.why: app.html has no viewport meta, which is true and affects mobile rendering.

ideas.idea: Wrap page content in a <main> landmark instead of a bare div
ideas.why: It is accurate (app.html uses a plain div), but it is a common best practice with little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add supporting detail for the 'shipped next day' claim
ideas.why: The claim is accurate, but the advice is vague and mostly content advice that would fit any shop.

ideas.idea: Fix the Product JSON-LD being injected via {@html} so it appears in served HTML (by re-enabling SSR) and add offers
ideas.why: This restates the known ssr=false and missing-offers problems rather than adding a new issue.
